newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hainan Dadonghai Travel B shr issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hainan Dadonghai Travel B shr issue oversubscribed.

text.p: China's Hainan Dadonghai Travel Centre Co Ltd said on Tuesday its 80 million B share issue, which was placed internationally, was oversubscribed but did not specify the subscription level.
The issue representing 25 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of Hainan Dadonghai was placed at HK$1.22 per share for a total of HK$97.6 million, it said.
Dealings in the shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange is expected to commence on or before October 25.
The company is an integrated tourism and entertainment operator in Sanya City, Hainan Island.
Hainan Dadonghai said the net proceeds of the B shares estimated at HK$86 million would be applied towards the construction and decoration of an annexe adjacent to the South China hotel.
This would bring the total size of the hotel to 450 guest rooms from existing 238 rooms, it said. -- HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843 6369
